rows.grounds: the individual self as subject of knowledge
the operative power associated with the self
conjoins the two subjects to be known
gerundive indicating what must be understood
detailed exposition; final visarga elided before following vowel
locative adverb indicating the present context; sandhi form

items.question: How must the self and its power be understood in the present exposition?
premises: The self is presented as an object of knowledge.
Power is presented together with the self as an object of knowledge.
A detailed exposition of these is announced for this context.
items.inference: Therefore, the self and its power must be known together through the elaboration that will be given here.
uncertainties: The exact doctrinal relation between ātmā and śakti in this passage depends on the forthcoming elaboration.
items.plain_english: The self and its power are to be known, and their detailed explanation will indeed be given here.
